# `logger.aug`

<a id="symbol-Logger"></a>
## `Logger` · interface · [source](logger.aug#L4)

Writes messages to an application log.

<a id="symbol-Logger.log"></a>
### `Logger.log` · [source](logger.aug#L9)

Writes one message. It takes `message` as a string (Text to write). It gets `console` ([`Console`](../.aug-spec/august/0.21.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console)) from dependency injection. It can call [`Console.write`](../.aug-spec/august/0.21.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console.write).

## Dependencies

It uses [`Console`](../.aug-spec/august/0.21.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console) ([`write`](../.aug-spec/august/0.21.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Console.write)) from `august.io`.
